description.value: Kapi Chido Coffee Roasters is an Indigenous-values-rooted roastery and cafe in West Kelowna that roasts all its coffee in-house and serves espresso drinks and vintage-inspired treats on-site. The business is guided by pillars of Care, Culture, and Community, with bean names drawn from Indigenous languages and wildlife. Cyclists passing through the Okanagan can visit the roastery to taste and purchase freshly roasted coffee, or order online for nationwide shipping.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Kapi Chido Coffee Roasters is a real, operating roastery and cafe at 101-3310 Carrington Road, West Kelowna, BC. The site describes on-site espresso drinks and treats, online coffee ordering, and nationwide shipping, confirming it is an active food-and-drink business. No OSM tags are present, so all evidence comes from the website content; cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are not mentioned on the site.
concerns: OSM record has no osm_id, no address, no phone, and no OSM tags — this listing appears to have been added manually rather than sourced from OpenStreetMap data.
OSM community is listed as Kelowna but the business address is West Kelowna (a separate municipality); coordinates should be verified against 101-3310 Carrington Road, West Kelowna.
No phone number found in OSM or on website contact page.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating roastery and cafe in West Kelowna with confirmed address and active website; a useful stop for touring cyclists seeking coffee and refreshments in the Okanagan.
enrichment_extras.notes: The café branding references Indigenous cultural values and uses Indigenous-language names for some coffee roasts (e.g., snk̓y̓ép Coyete Decaf). This may be of particular interest to cyclists seeking locally distinctive or culturally meaningful stops.
